verdict.rationale: Helicone has no documented sandbox or test mode. The closest evidence is a Docker Compose self-host option described as ideal for local development, which could serve as an isolated instance. There is also a Playground for testing prompts, sessions and traces in the UI, but nothing says it is kept apart from production data. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or separate dev/prod projects, explicit isolation from production data, test API keys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
